verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI is an open-source Python library, not a hosted SaaS, so there's no vendor data silo to escape from — but it does document that full message history from agent runs is accessible and serializable, and community users cite JSON serialize/deserialize of conversations as a valued feature. This covers 'open format export' of conversation data but doesn't map cleanly onto a full 'export everything and leave' story since there's no platform lock-in to begin with. Missing for 10: explicit data-export/portability documentation beyond message history, no discussion of exporting traces/evals/other artifacts in open formats, no independent audit of format openness.
